title: Compose explicit Plant State human review

gates.name: plant_state_review_browser
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/plant-state-review.spec.ts

verify: Independent review verification covers exact decision/expected_version bodies, Boss/Engineer success, Consultant/read-only/archive denial, version/conflict failures, and post-request authority state.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-024 RED: no browser Plant State review consumer exists; GREEN: exact authorized confirm/reject succeeds while version/conflict/Consultant/read-only/archive requests fail without changing the authoritative record; decisive comparison: strict request body, response/DOM, and post-request record/version; artifact: Plant State review evidence under .tasks/TASK-103-T3-FT-016-W3/.
purpose: Expose the versioned human trust-review mutation independently of Plant State list presentation.
success_outcome: Authorized Boss/Engineer users can submit only decision and expected_version while every conflict or denied path leaves backend trust authority unchanged.
anti_goals: Do not implement the list projection, accept trust/evidence/agent/Safety fields, or add batch review.
Do not auto-resolve conflicts, create Tasks, or approve physical actions.

stop_conditions: The PWA needs a trust mutation outside the exact review contract.
A conflict or archived path cannot fail without optimistic/client-owned trust state.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA; Plant State owns records, conflicts, evidence, and review transitions.
Client bodies contain only decision and expected_version.
invariants: Plant state is never confirmed by model or UI presentation alone.
Consultant/read-only/archived/stale requests never mutate trust records.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-024: exact versioned review success and conflict/role/read-only/archive denial with post-request authoritative comparison.
T3 harm proof uses isolated records and verifies safe rerun/denial leaves no unintended trust transition.
